info.longName: Wisdomtree Bianco Fixed Income Total Return Fund

funds_data.description: Under normal circumstances, the fund primarily invests in the constituent exchange-traded funds (“ETF”) of the index. The index, created by Bianco Research Advisors LLC, is composed of approximately 5 to 20 fixed income ETFs that are specifically selected and weighted using a modified market-capitalization weighting scheme to achieve specified factor exposures. It is non-diversified.
